fr_html: MM. ROOT et HAGERUP s'opposent à la fixation du traitement des suppléants à un tiers de celui des titulaires.
en_html: Mr. ROOT and M. HAGERUP were opposed to the idea of fixing the salary of the deputy-judges at one third of that of the judges.
